drooler.tactics: Sprint runner. Staggers easily from headshots; avoid getting cornered in tight doorways.

brute.tactics: Heavy club attacks deal devastating damage. Parry or maintain distance with thrusts/firearms.

bloat.tactics: Detonates on death dealing lethal AOE poison. Snipe from range or wear gas mask.

shambler.tactics: Slow moving horde infesting compounds. Easily dispatched with blunt or heavy overheads.

dreg.tactics: Common scavengers patrolling trails. Weak individually but dangerous when swarming.

pale-lady.tactics: Ultra rare spectral boss rolling on the Miniboss table (1 raid in 1.6 overall). Keep extreme range.

farmer-dreg.tactics: Elite pitchfork variant of Dreg. Only 1 static spawner exists on Sarlat Farm at Garnier's Farm.
